messages.subject: Sterling reservation of rights — urgent
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As you know we've had a reservation of rights letter from Sterling following the September covenant test. The board is meeting on 1 December and we need to move quickly. Can Whitfield Carter act for us on the restructuring? Grace can get you the September compliance certificate and the latest management accounts today.

Best,
Richard

Richard Pennington
Chair & Chief Executive
Pennington Industries Limited

messages.subject: RE: Sterling reservation of rights — urgent
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Yes, we'd be glad to act. I've run our conflicts check — all clear. I attach our engagement letter (our ref WC-00161, codename Project Mallory) setting out scope, team and fees; please sign and return the enclosed copy. James Osei (Senior Associate) and Elena Marchetti will support me.

First priorities: (1) appoint an independent business reviewer acceptable to Sterling — I suggest Duncan Reeves at Marlow Tax; (2) start a weekly 13-week cashflow to the bank; (3) hold the line on any shareholder payments. I'll circulate an options paper before the board meeting.

Best,
Sarah
